SHA top 30 non-offer ads

Meta, last 90 days (to 2026-10-06), ads with at least $2k spend, ranked by contribution-margin ROAS (1.00 = breakeven). 30 ads, $216,932 total spend.

Excluded as offer/scarcity: statics with angle Direct Offer, Scarcity and Urgency, Price and Value Emphasis, or primary lever = offer; videos whose promise or hook is a discount, sale, bundle deal, free items or urgency. An offer line only in a video's closing CTA does not exclude it. Funnel notes compare each ad to the median of these 30.
